body_markdown:
Agents are only as capable as the context they can reach. An agent with reliable access to the right information makes decisions grounded in fact; one without it guesses. And the work agents produce is itself a critical asset: every execution trace, intermediate result, and outcome is the raw material teams need to evaluate, debug, and improve them. In practice, that context is scattered across documents, video and audio libraries, operational databases, and execution logs, each with its own format, access pattern, and freshness guarantees. Making it usable means building and maintaining transcription jobs, indexing pipelines, and sync scripts, and keeping them coherent as the sources change. The quality of an agent is bounded by the quality of this data foundation, which is why it deserves to be engineered as deliberately as the agent itself.


DigitalOcean Agent Data Services, now in private preview, gives agents one managed place to read the context they need and write back what happened. Data Flows process, enrich, and index new data as it arrives; so multimodal content, structured records, and agent sessions land in one governed catalog, searchable by meaning in a single call.


It runs on the same cloud as your compute and models, so you can build search, analytics, and agents on your own data without running your own pipeline infrastructure. It’s also the data layer for DigitalOcean Learning Services, so teams can use those sessions to test changes and improve their agents over time.


## One managed service instead of fragmented data stores


DigitalOcean Agent Data Services consolidates the work of a multi-vendor data stack with a single, fully managed context substrate. Designed specifically for AI-native teams and autonomous agents, Agent Data Services bridges the gap between raw data ingestion and live application reasoning, reducing the engineering overhead standing between your models and production.


At its core, Agent Data Services delivers the following foundational capabilities:


-


**Managed Data Flows:** New data is processed, vector-indexed, and enriched by the Data Flows you set up, with no pipelines to manage yourself.


-


**Data Catalog** : Structured records and vectors sit together in a single governed catalog, with lineage back to the source.


-


**Query through SQL and API:** Ask your data a question in SQL, or call it from your agents through an API.


-


**Built on DigitalOcean:** Runs on the same cloud platform where your compute, inference models, and managed databases already live.


## How It Works: Under the Hood


At a high level, Agent Data Services acts as a unified data bridge between your raw data sources and your AI applications. The platform handles the end-to-end lifecycle from raw ingestion and automated multimodal processing to indexing and real-time execution tracing, storing it in one logically isolated catalog, queryable via standard SQL, vector search, or developer APIs:


Agent Data Services integrates with DigitalOcean Managed Agents or operates as a powerful standalone workspace. You can easily connect both internal and external data sources, from DigitalOcean Spaces to third-party cloud storage providers.


## Real-World Applications and Key Benefits


Developers can use Agent Data Services to turn raw multimodal content into AI-ready context and transform agent behavior into structured data their models learn from.


**Use-cases:**


-


**Agent Execution Traces and Memory:** Capturing multi-step agent execution loops and feeding session state back to RAG applications in real time.


-


**Video and Media Search:** Making video libraries searchable by meaning, subtitle, and category without manually tagging pipelines.


-


**Multimodal Support and Knowledge Archives:** Unifying images, audio recordings, and call transcripts, and product documentation into a single queryable endpoint.


**Key benefits:**


-


**Bring in any data.** Images, audio, video, documents, structured records, and the traces your agents emit as they run, all land in one place.


-


**Data flows make it AI-ready.** Every new arrival runs through the steps you set and comes out structured and ready to query, with no pipeline infrastructure for you to provision or maintain.


-


**One catalog holds it all.** Structured records and vectors sit together in a single governed catalog, with lineage back to the source and no separate vector database for you to provision and maintain.


-


**Query over SQL and API.** Ask your data a question in SQL, or call it from your agents through an API, so people and agents work from the same fresh data.


-


**Governed by default** Scoped access per workspace, roles from your DigitalOcean team, API tokens, and audit logging for workspace and access events.


## Integration with the DigitalOcean Ecosystem


Agent Data Services serves as the core context substrate for DigitalOcean’s broader AI-Native Cloud. Running natively alongside DigitalOcean[Serverless Inference](http://docs.digitalocean.com/reference/api/reference/serverless-inference/) ,[Managed Agents](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/managed-agents) , and[Spaces](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/spaces) , Agent Data Services gives your data a permanent, intelligent home. Models running on DigitalOcean can pull permitted, up-to-date context from Agent Data Services without developers having to write custom pipeline glue code.


Since Agent Data Services captures runtime execution traces and behavioral telemetry. It serves as the foundation for the agent feedback loop, converting agent turns, tool calls, and session history into structured, queryable context.


This continuous data stream connects directly into DigitalOcean’s broader observability and evaluation suite, including[Insights](https://www.digitalocean.com/blog/introducing-insights) and[Agent Learning Services](https://www.digitalocean.com/blog/introducing-signals-and-simulations) (Signals, Evaluations, and Simulations). By providing a single store where agents seamlessly read live knowledge and write back execution results, Agent Data Services provides the data foundation necessary for teams to evaluate, refine, and continuously improve their agents over time.
